asset.name: Contract signed
asset.description: Sent to the contract owner when DocuSign reports the envelope completed, with a link to the signed PDF.
asset.subject: Signed: {{contract_title}} ({{counterparty}})
asset.html_body:
The contract is signed

{{contract_title}} with {{counterparty}} (value {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(contract_value, 2)}}) was signed by {{signer_name}}.

Open the signed PDF (DocuSign envelope {{envelope.envelope_id}}).

It is also recorded in the Signed contracts table.
asset.text_body:
The contract is signed
  {{contract_title}} with {{counterparty}} (value {{=FORMAT_NUMBER(contract_value, 2)}}) was signed by {{signer_name}}.
  Signed PDF: {{signature.signed_document.url}} (DocuSign envelope {{envelope.envelope_id}}).
  It is also recorded in the Signed contracts table.
